ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points $C$ and $D$ divide the line segment $AB$ into three parts in the ratio $2\colon 5\colon 3$, with $E$ being the midpoint of $AB$. If the numbers represented by points $A$, $B$, and $D$ are $-10$, $+20$, and $x$ respectively, what is the value of $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the problem, the numbers represented by points $A$, $B$, $D$ are respectively $-10$, $+20$, $x$,\\
$\therefore AB=20-(-10)=30$, $BD=20-x$,\\
$\because$ On the number line, points $C$ and $D$ divide segment $AB$ into three parts in the ratio $2\colon 5\colon 3$,\\
$\therefore BD=\frac{3}{2+5+3}AB=\frac{3}{10}\times 30=9$,\\
$\therefore 20-x=9$,\\
$\therefore x=\boxed{11}$.
